name: Deploy on Release Created

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  validate-and-bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production-release

    steps:
      - name: Generate a GitHub App token
        id: generate-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.BOT_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: main
          token: ${{ steps.generate-token.outputs.token }}

      - name: Configure Git User
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Validate release tag version
        id: validate-version
        env:
          TAG_NAME: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
        run: |
          # Strip leading 'v' from tag if present
          CLEAN_TAG="${TAG_NAME#v}"
          echo "tag_version=$CLEAN_TAG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          
          node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const currentVersion = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')).version;
            const tagVersion = '$CLEAN_TAG';
            
            function parseVersion(v) {
              return v.split('.').map(Number);
            }
            
            const [cMajor, cMinor, cPatch] = parseVersion(currentVersion);
            const [tMajor, tMinor, tPatch] = parseVersion(tagVersion);
            
            if (tMajor < cMajor || 
                (tMajor === cMajor && tMinor < cMinor) || 
                (tMajor === cMajor && tMinor === cMinor && tPatch < cPatch)) {
              console.error(\`Error: Release version \${tagVersion} is less than current version \${currentVersion}\`);
              process.exit(1);
            } else {
              console.log(\`Success: Release version \${tagVersion} is >= current version \${currentVersion}\`);
            }
          "

      - name: Update version to release tag
        run: |
          npm version ${{ steps.validate-version.outputs.tag_version }} --no-git-tag-version

      - name: Commit and push version change
        run: |
          git add package.json package-lock.json
          git commit -m "chore: release version ${{ steps.validate-version.outputs.tag_version }} [skip ci]"
          git push origin main

  deploy:
    needs: validate-and-bump
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_firebase_deploy.yml
    secrets:
      PRODUCTION_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_CLIENT_ID }}
      FIREBASE_IDENTITY_PROVIDER: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}
      FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
      FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID }}
